note: Wall-clock and peak-RSS overhead of provenance annotation vs. a provenance-disabled scan, on a synthetic 15-file/3-commit-each git fixture. cold = fresh provenance cache; warm = second with-provenance pass against the same fixture/HEAD, so the on-disk provenance cache is hit. Each dimension is a distribution over n=20 iterations (nearest-rank percentiles, matching posture/fix-metrics.js's convention); the gated number is the p95 of the per-iteration ratio, not a single sample. Memory ratio dimensions are gated with extra additive headroom (MEMORY_RATIO_ADDITIVE_MARGIN) because they are measurably noisier than the time-ratio dimensions — see runner.mjs for both that and why the ratio itself is a REGRESSION signal against ITS OWN prior baseline, not a literal FR-PROV-029 percentage claim.
